biography.background:
« Keyside » est un Pixar Hacker spécialisé "Malware", il utilise la technologie et ses armes à distance pour introduire des virus dans les équipements de ses adversaires, avant de les propager aux ennemis proches.

Comment jouer Keyside ?

  • Vos 6 bras de Pixar vous permettent d'aider vos alliés, même après qu'ils aient lancé les dés ! Voir @UUID[Compendium.daggerheart-scifi-content.character-options.qB5mETT7yXGZ72p7]{Helpful to a Fault}.

  • « Keyside » a passé sa vie dans l'espace. Il a l'habitude de piloter ou de se déplacer en apesanteur.

  • Si un vous ou un allié faites une erreur, faites un restart avec @UUID[Compendium.daggerheart-scifi-content.character-options.tBAeJc6NJtn47pdQ]{Hack Me Back In Time} !

  • Vos attaques permettent de trouver des failles et de provoquer une @UUID[Compendium.daggerheart-scifi-content.character-options.y4cUUgwOuWBlzF1e]{Intrusion} ainsi que des @UUID[Compendium.daggerheart-scifi-content.character-options.ipaUsRjjzM5mxZDu]{Viral Payload} qui vous permettent de leur faire plus de dégâts et de les affaiblir !

  • Piratez les terminaux informatiques ou ouvrez les portes, d'autant que vous avez @UUID[Compendium.daggerheart.domains.HdgZUfWd7Hyj7nBW]{Pick and Pull} !

system.description:
On a successful weapon attack or Tech domain attack, you can mark a Stress to breach into the target eletronic defenses and make the target Breached.

When you deal damage to a target you Breached, add 1d6 to the damage roll.

You can only have one Breached adversary at a time. This condition lasts until you take a rest or the adversary is defeated.
When your or an ally within Far range fails an action roll, you can Spend 3 Hope to change it into a success with Fear instead.
Hackers manipulate the battlefield through information warfare, cyber intrusion, and electronic disruption. They turn every piece of technology into a weapon.
You can comfortably carry and manipulate several objects simultaneously.
Once per Scene, when an ally within Close range fails a roll, you may immediately Help them after the fact if the fiction allows.
You have Advantage on rolls to pilot spacecraft, maneuver in zero gravity, or maintain your balance in unusual gravity.

After a rest, place up to 4 Virus tokens on this card.

When you make a successful weapon attack, you can spend a token to afflict the target with a virus. Choose a virus:

  • Zero day: The next attack against the target has Advantage.

  • Segmentation fault: The target has disadvantage on its next attack.

  • Stacktrace: You always know the target's location until the end of the scene.
When you deal damage to an adversary infected by one of your Virus, you can mark a Stress to force them to mark an additional Hit Point.

When you deliver a @UUID[Compendium.daggerheart-scifi-content.character-options.ipaUsRjjzM5mxZDu]{Viral Payload} to a Breached target, you can spend an additional Virus token to spread a second virus to the same target or deliver the same virus to another target within Close range of the Breached target.

You also know these Viruses to deliver with @UUID[Compendium.daggerheart-scifi-content.character-options.ipaUsRjjzM5mxZDu]{Viral Payload}:

  • Infinite loop: The target must mark a Stress.

  • DDoS: The target becomes temporarily Vulnerable.

You also know these Viruses to deliver with @UUID[Compendium.daggerheart-scifi-content.character-options.ipaUsRjjzM5mxZDu]{Viral Payload}:

  • Circuit eating worm: The target has a -3 penalty to their damage thresholds until the end of the scene.

  • Shutdown: The target has a -2 penalty to their Difficulty until the end of the scene.

Pixars are energetic, small, six-armed humanoids with brightly colored fur. Pixars accomplish tasks with chaotic enthusiasm and typically enjoy teamwork, defying even their would-be conquerors through collaboration.
Play the Malware if you want to deliver viral payloads to the enemies you hit, applying various weaknesses for your allies or yourself to benefit from.

Being part of a spaceborne community means you were raised aboard spacecraft, orbital stations, or deep-space habitats rather than on the surface of a planet. You instinctively understand the rhythms of life in confined environments, from long voyages between the stars to emergency decompressions and zero-gravity maintenance. To a spaceborne person, an airlock feels as familiar as a front door.

Spaceborne are often adaptable, daring, disciplined, practical, resilient, and curious.

There is tech everywhere, everyone wears some, there are cables in the walls and in the floor.

Spend a Hope to make a Spellcast Roll and overload a piece of tech at Far range, that strike out at all targets within Very Close range of that tech. Targets you succeed against take d8+3 magic damage using your Proficiency.
